reasoning_content:
Progress:
- uv cache: 565MB downloaded so far. Package list is progressing (now downloading smaller packages - good sign that the big wheels are nearly done).
- Docker pulls: pgvector, auto-setup, admin-tools done. Currently pulling temporal UI.

Continue waiting. In the meantime, plan the fake LLM server: write a minimal FastAPI/uvicorn or http.server-based OpenAI-compatible server:
- GET /v1/models → list gpt-oss-120b, bge-m3, gemma-3-12b-it (model names used by modules)
- POST /v1/chat/completions → return a fixed valid JSON content
- POST /v1/embeddings → return 1024-dimensional deterministic vectors

Which model names do the modules use? From comments in process-compose: "self-hosted/gpt-oss-120b, Qwen/..., bge-m3, gemma-...". The fake server should accept any model name.

Let me check the .env.local of the relevant modules to figure out the exact model names, and make sure the fake server's /v1/models includes them (in case some client validates model name against /v1/models - rare, but cheap).

Actually simpler: the server accepts everything; /v1/models returns a superset of all names found in .env.local files.

Let me grep the model names.
